question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how obese children are more likely to suffer from health issues as they grow up.
 
• The preposition that correctly fits with the phrase "prone to" is "to."
 
• "**To**" is appropriate because "prone" is commonly followed by the preposition "to" to indicate susceptibility.
 
• Other options ("**at**", "**in**", "**on**") do not fit grammatically or contextually in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Many parents think of overweight children as ‘cute’ and cuddly. However, obesity must not be 1.* *seen__* *as a healthy sign. 2. __**When**__ obese children grow up, they will be more prone 3. __**to**__ health problems like high blood pressure 4. __**and**__ diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common 5. __**sight**__ in many countries.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• At (पर): "At" does not grammatically fit with "prone."
 
• In (में): "In" does not grammatically fit with "prone."
 
• On (पर): "On" does not grammatically fit with "prone."
